signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION DLANSB( NORM, UPLO, N, K, AB, LDAB,

params.name: norm
params.reference: Specifies the value to be returned in DLANSB as described above.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
Specifies whether the upper or lower triangular part of the band matrix A is supplied.

-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular part is supplied
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular part is supplied

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$. When $N = 0$, DLANSB is set to zero.

params.name: K
params.reference: The number of super-diagonals or sub-diagonals of the band matrix A. $K \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: The upper or lower triangle of the symmetric band matrix A, stored in the first K+1 rows of `AB`. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(k+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-k) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+k)$.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge K+1$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: where $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge N$ when `NORM = 'I'` or '1' or 'O'; otherwise, `WORK` is not referenced.

notes: no derivable minimum length for workspace WORK
